report_name: US Sanctions Iranian MOIS Hackers for Critical Infrastructure Attacks

threat_actors.name: MOIS-affiliated actors
threat_actors.description: A group of Iranian cyber actors linked to Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS), responsible for widespread attacks on U.S. critical infrastructure, government offices, and defense contractors since late 2023. The group exhibits a dual motivation, blending state-directed espionage with financially motivated cybercrime for personal gain.
threat_actors.goals: To conduct state-sponsored espionage, gather intelligence, pre-position for disruptive attacks, and engage in financially motivated theft, including stealing cryptocurrency.

threat_actors.name: Mabna Institute
threat_actors.description: A notorious Iranian hacking-for-hire organization linked to the sanctioned MOIS-affiliated actors, indicating a complex web of interconnected threat groups.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors exploited known vulnerabilities in public-facing applications such as VPNs, web servers, and Microsoft Exchange servers for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Password Spraying
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors frequently used password spraying as an initial access technique.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors likely used spearphishing campaigns for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Web Shell
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors deployed web shells on compromised servers to maintain persistence.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors used tools like Mimikatz to dump credentials from the LSASS process memory.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data
attack_patterns.description: Data was compressed into archives, such as RAR files, before being exfiltrated.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Data was exfiltrated over common protocols like HTTP/S to blend in with normal network traffic.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors used PowerShell for downloading remote scripts or executing obfuscated commands.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: Used by the threat actors to dump credentials from memory, specifically from the LSASS process.

campaigns.name: Operation Economic Outcast
campaigns.description: A U.S. government campaign, including sanctions from the Department of the Treasury, designed to disrupt the financial support systems of the MOIS-affiliated cyber actors.

identities.name: Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS)
identities.description: The Iranian government intelligence agency that directs the sanctioned group of cyber actors.

identities.name: U.S. Critical Infrastructure
identities.description: A primary target class for the MOIS-affiliated actors, encompassing sectors such as energy, defense, healthcare, finance, and U.S. water systems.

identities.name: Iranian Companies
identities.description: A target class for the MOIS-affiliated actors, who conducted attacks against them for financial gain and cryptocurrency theft.

identities.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury
identities.description: The U.S. government agency that announced sanctions against the Iranian cyber actors.

identities.name: U.S. Department of Justice
identities.description: The U.S. government agency that coordinated with the Treasury on an indictment related to the threat actors.

infrastructure.name: Iranian C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control infrastructure used by the MOIS-affiliated actors to manage compromised systems and exfiltrate data.

infrastructure.name: Cryptocurrency Wallet Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and TRON cryptocurrency wallets used by the threat actors for illicit financial activities, including laundering stolen funds.

indicators.name: High Volume of Failed Logins from Single IP (Password Spraying)
indicators.pattern:
title: High Volume of Failed Logins from Single IP
id: 2b9e1f3a-7c4d-4b8a-9f0e-1d2c3b4a5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of failed login attempts from a single source IP address, which could indicate a password spraying attack against VPN or other authentication services.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/us-sanctions-iran-linked-hackers-behind.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1110.003
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: vpn
detection:
  selection:
    action: 'failure'
  condition: selection | count(user) by source_ip > 20
indicators.description: Detects a high volume of failed login attempts from a single source IP, indicative of password spraying attacks mentioned in the report.

indicators.name: Microsoft Exchange OWA Exploit Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Microsoft Exchange OWA Exploit Attempt
id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3e-4d2c-8b9a-0e1f2d3c4b5a
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests to /owa/auth/logon.aspx, which is a common target for exploitation by Iranian threat actors.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/us-sanctions-iran-linked-hackers-behind.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains: '/owa/auth/logon.aspx'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests targeting Microsoft Exchange OWA, a common TTP for the described threat actors.

indicators.name: Suspicious PowerShell Download Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: PowerShell Network Connection and Script Download
id: 5a4b3c2d-1f0e-4b8a-9f7c-6d5e4f3a2b1c
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell executing commands to download remote scripts or payloads.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/us-sanctions-iran-linked-hackers-behind.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'iwr '
      - 'iex '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects PowerShell being used to download remote scripts, a behavior noted in the report's hunting hints.

indicators.name: LSASS Memory Dumping via Procdump
indicators.pattern:
title: LSASS Memory Dumping with Procdump
id: 1c2d3b4a-5e6f-4a9f-8e7d-6c5b4a3f2e1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of procdump.exe to dump the memory of the LSASS process, a common credential access technique.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/us-sanctions-iran-linked-hackers-behind.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.credential_access
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\procdump.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '-ma'
      - 'lsass.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific command line pattern for dumping LSASS memory with procdump.exe, as mentioned in the hunting hints.

indicators.name: Suspicious RAR Archive Creation on Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious RAR Archive Creation
id: 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-4f3e-8d7c-6b5a4f3e2d1c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of large RAR archives on sensitive servers, which could be a precursor to data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/us-sanctions-iran-linked-hackers-behind.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rar.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' a '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of RAR archives, a technique used by the actors for staging data for exfiltration.
